items.text: Grant application — Round 2 submission checklist. Applicants must upload the budget spreadsheet alongside the narrative before 5 pm on 14 March. Our automated tool checks file formats but does not read the narrative, so please proofread it yourself. The system will close the portal at the deadline and will not accept late entries. If you have questions about the instructions, email grants@harlowtrust.org.uk and a programme officer will reply within three working days.

Lost parcel notice: Parcel PQ-4471 from Fernwood Supplies was last scanned at the Coventry depot on Tuesday and has not moved since. Please open a claim with the courier if it does not arrive by Friday.

Vendor contract summary for the Brightwell renewal. Section 4 sets out the payment schedule: three instalments, each due within 30 days of invoice. The confidentiality clause survives termination for five years, which Legal flagged as longer than our standard. Note that the vendor's onboarding chatbot is mentioned in Schedule B as part of the delivered service, but the contract does not set any performance targets for it. Do not reply to the vendor's account manager directly; route all correspondence through procurement@northgate-ops.com.

The evaluation panel met on Wednesday and scored all eleven grant applications. Two proposals were sent back because the budget instructions had not been followed. Applicants who wish to appeal should write to the trust secretary within ten days; the system does not allow resubmission of the same project in the same funding year. A full list of decisions will be posted on the notices page.
Courier update: your parcel has been handed to a local delivery partner and should arrive Thursday. No action is needed.
The contract's termination clause allows either party to give 60 days' written notice; see clause 9.2 for the exclusions relating to confidentiality obligations.

How we assess grant applications

Every application is read by two assessors and then discussed at a panel meeting. We score against four criteria: need, feasibility, budget discipline and evidence of community support. The instructions to assessors are published in the trust's handbook, and applicants are welcome to read them before applying.

Budgets are checked separately by our finance team. A spreadsheet tool flags arithmetic errors, but it is only a first pass; a person always reviews the numbers afterwards. If a budget does not add up, we contact the applicant rather than rejecting the proposal outright.

We receive a lot of questions about the confidentiality of personal details. Names of individual beneficiaries should not appear in the narrative; describe the group instead. All application materials are held in the trust's system for seven years and are not shared with other funders.

Finally, do not reply to the automatic acknowledgement email. It is generated by our grants chatbot and is not monitored. Direct any follow-up questions to the programme office, and include your application reference in the subject line.
Tracking reference PQ-4471: the courier's chatbot says the parcel is delayed at the Coventry depot. If it has not arrived by Friday, please call 0800 118 4471.
Vendors must sign the confidentiality schedule before work begins; unsigned copies will be returned by the contracts system.

We have had a few questions about the renewal, so here is a short summary. The Brightwell contract renews automatically unless either side gives notice, and the notice period is 60 days. Their support chatbot is included in the standard package and is the usual first point of contact for account queries, though you can always ask for a named account manager instead. Confidentiality terms carry over for five years after the contract ends, as noted in the schedule. Procurement has asked that all correspondence go through their shared inbox rather than individual staff members.
